summary.motive: Use the stick as bait to occupy the nickel and Will, then attack the vacated middle with the tight end's twelve-yard crosser.
summary.whyItWorks: The vertical clearouts remove corner help, the stick removes the nickel, and the crosser arrives in the middle hole exactly as both linebackers are facing the wrong way.
summary.failureMode: The Mike sinks deeper instead of opening flat, keeping his body between the quarterback and the crosser's climbing lane.

beats.title: 1. The Clearouts Leave First
beats.text: Both outside receivers fire instant vertical releases, pinning each corner in his deep third so no underneath help exists on the perimeter.

beats.title: 2. The Stick Draws the Nickel
beats.text: The slot breaks his five-yard stick with outside leverage, and the nickel sits on it perfectly. The quarterback acknowledges but does not force it.

beats.title: 3. The Crosser Climbs Underneath
beats.text: The tight end wins inside and climbs to twelve yards, breaking down directly through the Mike's face while the Sam is still turned chasing him vertically.

beats.title: 4. Behind the Free Safety's Shoulder
beats.text: With both corners held deep and the hooks trailing, the crosser works into the soft spot behind the free safety's break for a big intermediate gain.

relations.tell: The tight end releases inside immediately — on mesh both crossers come from slots; here only one crosser ever appears.
